name: Reveler of Stories (Hero)

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Hero form (AC 17 and Speed 60 ft. with its shield).

traits.name: Moral Quandary
traits.summary: As a Bonus Action, a creature can recite the moral of a story of the reveler's theme: for 1 hour it can't take Reactions and its AC is 4 lower.
traits.text: As a Bonus Action, a creature can recite the moral of a story that shares the theme of the reveler's Storied Form. The reveler is weakened for 1 hour: it can't take Reactions and its AC is reduced by 4.

traits.name: Storied Form (Hero)
traits.summary: This is the Hero form: it embodies tales of brave heroes.
traits.text: The reveler takes one form: Great Beast, Hero or Witch. The form sets some traits and the theme of stories it embodies (powerful monsters, brave heroes, wicked magicians). This block is the Hero form.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Three Thrash attacks; one can be its Fabled Assault when ready.
actions.text: The reveler makes three Thrash attacks. It can replace one with its Fabled Assault if that is ready.

actions.name: Thrash
actions.text: A blow of storybook force: 18 (3d8 + 5) Force damage.

actions.name: Heroic Charge (Fabled Assault, Hero)
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Moves up to its Speed in a line with no Opportunity Attacks, through creatures; each creature whose space it enters: DC 17 Str save, 4d12 Force (half on a success) and Prone on a failure.
actions.text: The reveler moves up to its Speed in a straight line without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and can move through other creatures at no extra cost. Strength save, DC 17, each creature whose space it enters. Failure: 26 (4d12) Force damage and the target is knocked Prone. Success: half damage only.

reactions.name: Dramatic Reversal
reactions.trigger: It is hit by an attack roll.
reactions.summary: Reaction: +4 AC against the attack that hit it, possibly turning it into a miss.
reactions.text: Trigger: an attack roll hits the reveler. Response: it adds 4 to its AC against that attack, which can turn the hit into a miss.

summary: A fiend born of old stories that hammers with storybook force, here in a heroic form that charges through foes with a shield.
